defects.stream: Stream 7: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration & Control Plane
defects.title: 9Router AI Gateway Process Dormancy & Non-Supervised Service Lifecycle
defects.evidence: Live discovery probe on http://127.0.0.1:20128 timed out (process dormant). Local scripts `ensure_9router.js` and `start_9router_hidden.ps1` exist but are not managed by a persistent OS background supervisor or Windows Service.
defects.impact: When 9Router is offline, local requests fallback to unbuffered OpenRouter free endpoints or stall. Risk of hitting 429 rate limits without local gateway caching and circuit breaking.
defects.root_cause: 9Router runs as an on-demand process rather than a resilient daemon or persistent local service supervised by the AIOS root orchestrator.
defects.remediation_proposal: Integrate an auto-start daemon hook into `scripts/aasha_root_orchestrator.js` and `package.json` entrypoints to verify port 20128 and spawn `start_9router_hidden.ps1` with unref() stdio prior to pipeline runs.

defects.stream: Stream 7: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration & Control Plane
defects.title: Dual Sub-Repository State Drift & Desynchronized Git Working Trees
defects.evidence: Root repo `NGO AI LLM` has untracked `LOCAL_AIOS_MASTER_PROMPT_PHASE_H016.json` and modified `scripts/aasha_continuous_loop.mjs`. Sub-repo `Aasha-AI` is an independent git repository with modified `aasha-pipeline-with-master-json/config/candidate_dictionary_hi.json`. Neither uses a formal Git submodule or synchronized atomic commit link.
defects.impact: Autonomous Gate 6 promotions or trunk synchronization could push desynchronized commit states between root and `Aasha-AI`, breaking multi-repo path resolutions and test baselines.
defects.root_cause: Nested repository structure without a strict multi-repo commit synchronization script or submodule pointer.
defects.remediation_proposal: Add pre-commit dual-repository dirty check in `scripts/lint_staged_secrets.mjs` and execute `scripts/sync_and_push_all_autonomous_cycles.mjs` with subrepo status assertions before any Gate 6 promotion.

defects.title: Subprocess Staging Latency & Ingestion Filesystem Overhead on Windows
defects.evidence: `Aasha-AI/agent_orchestrator.ts` invokes the Python ingestion worker (`ingest_agent.py`) via subprocess spawning and intermediate file staging (`raw_extract.json`). Verified in RG-002 as an accepted current implementation characteristic.
defects.impact: Windows process creation overhead (~500ms-1500ms per spawn) introduces latency during batch multi-chapter compilation. Not a correctness bug, but creates a batch scaling bottleneck.
defects.root_cause: Lack of a persistent in-memory streaming IPC daemon between Node.js and Python runtimes.
defects.remediation_proposal: Maintain current accepted status until multi-chapter batch requirements mandate an in-memory resident JSON-RPC / stdio daemon.

defects.stream: Stream 5: Indic Language Layer Engine (LLE) & Bilingual Substrate
defects.title: Monolingual Hindi LLE Active Substrate & Nested LaTeX Formula Collision Risk
defects.evidence: `docs/FINAL_MULTI_AGENT_SYSTEM.md` and `GEMINI.md` confirm Hindi is currently the sole active Indic substrate. Complex multi-line or nested LaTeX environments (e.g. `\begin{aligned}`, `\frac` with nested sub-expressions) can occasionally fail regex placeholder insulation (`__AASHA_MATH_X__`), risking false dictionary translation.
defects.impact: Math symbols could be wrapped in transliteration tags (`rt()`), corrupting KaTeX formula rendering on client mobile WebViews.
defects.root_cause: Regex-based math insulation rather than a formal AST LaTeX tokenizer.
defects.remediation_proposal: Upgrade `packages/aasha-rules/math_insulator.ts` to use a lightweight AST-based LaTeX tokenizer for math boundary detection before invoking the Hindi dictionary regex replace.

defects.title: Distractor Misconception Spoiler Generation Rate & Repair-Loop Quarantine Risk
defects.evidence: Assessment generation frequently trips Rule #1 Zero-Spoiler regex in distractor explanations (`m` attribute) during initial LLM prompt generation. The 2-tier repair loop catches and remediates them, but repair exhaustion triggers `QuarantineError` and downstream stage blocking.
defects.impact: Chapters with persistent spoiler leaks halt the automated pipeline at Stage 3, requiring manual Super Admin intervention and blocking downstream assembly.
defects.root_cause: Assessment prompts allow LLMs to freely generate misconception text before post-hoc regex evaluation, rather than enforcing structured, spoiler-free diagnostic templates at the prompt level.
defects.remediation_proposal: Enforce strict distractor misconception templates in `AssessmentAgent` system prompt and run `sanitize_spec_misconceptions()` pre-filtering on candidate outputs before ContextBus validation.

defects.stream: Stream 6: Single-File HTML5 Compiler & Offline Edge Runtime
defects.title: Standalone Bundle Size Variance on Asset-Heavy Chapters (Fractions 6.47MB)
defects.evidence: Audit of `chapters/*Gamified*.html` shows most chapters are lightweight (80KB-350KB), but `Fractions_Gamified_v5_(2)_Enhanced_v6.html` reaches 6.47 MB due to heavy inlined raster graphics and SVG assets.
defects.impact: While strictly within the 20 MiB ceiling, a 6.47 MB single-file HTML bundle causes memory spikes on ultra-budget Android Go devices (1GB RAM) during initial WebKit DOM parsing.
defects.root_cause: Inclusion of unoptimized raster images converted to raw Base64 data URIs without Pillow downsampling.
defects.remediation_proposal: Mandate web-optimized Pillow JPEG downsampling (max width 1000px, quality 80, alpha=False) in compiler asset pipeline for all raster graphics, targeting <1.0 MB per chapter.

defects.stream: Stream 9: Verification, Quality Assurance & Telemetry Governance
defects.title: Upstream Provider Billing Telemetry Observability Gap (OI-001 / RG-004)
defects.evidence: Local guards (`ALLOW_PAID_GEMINI_FALLBACK=false`, spend cap ledger in `router_usage.json` with $10.00 daily limit) are verified, but external provider-side billing balances cannot be programmatically queried from the developer runtime.
defects.impact: Upstream provider billing is not externally observable at runtime; zero paid token usage cannot be certified provider-side without manual dashboard inspection.
defects.root_cause: OpenRouter and Google Cloud do not expose authenticated client-side balance webhooks in this project.
defects.remediation_proposal: Maintain formal bounding per `docs/FINAL_MULTI_AGENT_SYSTEM.md`: client guards certified, provider telemetry accepted as local limitation (OI-001).

defects.stream: Stream 8: Multi-Tier Persistent Memory & Local State Hierarchy
defects.title: Dual-Plane SQLite Database Telemetry Synchronization Asynchrony
defects.evidence: Root database `aasha_operational.db` maintains concept nodes and operational states, while `Aasha-AI/server/offline_sync.db` stores evidence ledgers and student sync data. Synchronization relies on discrete CLI scripts (`npm run memory:sync`) rather than automated bi-directional event publishing.
defects.impact: Evidence ledger records generated during subrepo tests may not immediately reflect in root operational state queries until explicit sync execution.
defects.root_cause: Dual-root workspace architecture without a unified SQLite shared database path or automated trigger.
defects.remediation_proposal: Configure a unified connection path or automated post-test sync hook in `agent_orchestrator.ts` to replicate evidence ledger writes across both databases.
